$comment: The single source of truth for 'which packages exist, where, and what mirrors/bundle-copies/copy-fidelity gates apply to them'. Consumed by tools/publish-mirror.mjs, tools/lib/check-drift-core.mjs (provenance/bundle-copy drift), tools/copy-fidelity.mjs, and tools/gate-all.mjs. Adding a 4th (or Nth) consumer package to any of these mechanisms is a DATA change here, not a code change in four places. Fixes Theme 3's 'manifest move' finding (docs/reviews/2026-08-17-thermonuclear-workspace-review.md, Theme 3 table + 'The manifest move (code judo)' paragraph) — publish-mirror.mjs's FAMILY (lines 56-70) and tools/lib/consumer-output-drift.mjs's independently-invented second one are both retired in favor of this file.

copyFidelity.$sourceDefaultNote: elm-m3e's reference advanced to latest main (D-041) via tools/fetch-snapshots.mjs into .cache/snapshots/elm-m3e, unlike every other package here which defaults to a $SNAPSHOT_ROOT/<name> sibling checkout.
copyFidelity.$sourceFilterNote: docs/** is excluded from the elm-m3e fidelity comparison entirely: repo-shape-v2 wave-1 (spec decision #9) EXTRACTED the docs site out of the elm-m3e package into its own sibling package (brands/m3e/generated/docs/elm-m3e-docs, no independent mirror), so the pinned jackhp95/elm-m3e mirror snapshot — which still carries the whole in-package docs/ tree until it is republished post-reshape — would otherwise flag all ~195 relocated docs/** files as spuriously 'missing'. This is the materialized-snapshot completion of plan Step 5.6 (the plan moved the docs-specific docs/dist/ + docs/vendor/ exclusions, but the whole subtree left the package). Subsumes the prior docs/dist/ (vite content-hashed build output) + docs/vendor/ exclusions. Narrow this back to a package-internal docs/ path only if docs ever returns to the elm-m3e package.
copyFidelity.$authorizedAbsentPrefixesNote: MIRROR-LAG (explosion Task 2, 2026-08-20): the pinned jackhp95/elm-m3e snapshot still carries elm-m3e-icons/ (and the pre-Task-1 elm-m3e-families/) NESTED under the package, but Task 2 promoted them to committed SIBLINGS under brands/m3e/generated/package/ (elm-m3e-icons/, elm-m3e-components/) — outside elm-m3e's srcDir. So the nested copies are legitimately absent from the workspace tree until the mirror is republished post-reshape (OQ-6). Same wave-1 tailwind/cfc mirror-lag pattern (see the elm-cem-figma-connect $mirrorLagNote). Remove these prefixes once jackhp95/elm-m3e is republished with the new sibling shape. (elm-m3e-components/ + elm-m3e-families/ are belt-and-suspenders: the current snapshot lacks them, but a re-pin between Task 1 and republish could carry either the old -families or the mid-move nested -components name.) NAMESPACE-RENAME MIRROR-LAG (reconciliation Task 7, 2026-08-21): the pinned mirror still emits the element-tier modules under the OLD `src/M3e/Component/*` namespace; Task 7 renamed them to `src/M3e/Element/*` (Component→Element) and family modules `M3e.Family.*`→`M3e.Component.*`. The 130 old `src/M3e/Component/*` files are legitimately absent until the mirror is republished post-rename (OQ-3/OQ-6). Remove `src/M3e/Component/` once jackhp95/elm-m3e is republished with the new namespaces.
copyFidelity.$authorizedExtraPrefixesNote: NAMESPACE-RENAME MIRROR-LAG (reconciliation Task 7, 2026-08-21): the workspace now emits the element-tier modules under the NEW `src/M3e/Element/*` namespace (Component→Element), but the pinned jackhp95/elm-m3e mirror snapshot still has them under the old `src/M3e/Component/*` path. The 130 new `src/M3e/Element/*` files are legitimately extra until the mirror is republished post-rename (OQ-3/OQ-6). Pairs with the `src/M3e/Component/` entry in authorizedAbsentPrefixes. Remove `src/M3e/Element/` once jackhp95/elm-m3e is republished with the new namespaces.
copyFidelity.$notes: Full per-path reasoning for every allowlist entry above (why each is authorized-absent or authorized-extra) lives in docs/copy-fidelity-notes.md#elm-m3e — moved there verbatim from this package's retired tools/copy-fidelity-elm-m3e.sh so the institutional memory survives the consolidation.

packages.$comment_elm_m3e_split_siblings: The six committed split/generator siblings materialized by explosion Task 2 (spec 2026-08-20-package-explosion-design.md §3.4 tree). core/elements/build/facts come from `elm-cem split --out=..` (elm-m3e/package.json `split`); icons/components from gen-icon-module/gen-family-package (slots.json _iconModule/_families dir → ../elm-m3e-{icons,components}). No copyFidelity block yet: OQ-6 (publishing / GitHub-mirror wiring) is out of scope for Task 2 — these have no published jackhp95/* mirror snapshot to compare against yet, same as elm-typed-html/elm-shoelace. Add a copyFidelity block per package when its mirror is first published (the immediate-next-priority per OQ-6).
packages.$comment_elm_typed_html_split_siblings: The three committed split siblings materialized by explosion Task 4 (facts/core/elements). html is a home-only brand (own=[]) so no build/components tier is derivable — 3 tiers is the real ceiling. Emitted by `elm-cem split --out=..` from elm-typed-html/packages.json. Unlike m3e's split, the TypedHtml barrel lives in the ELEMENTS tier (home Component modules fuse types+surface, so the barrel has a hard elements dependency; barrel-in-core would need a cross-brand home-emitter decoupling out of Task 4 scope — see elm-typed-html/packages.json $scopeNote). No copyFidelity block yet: no published jackhp95/* mirror snapshot to compare against (same as elm-typed-html/elm-shoelace, OQ-6).

elm-shoelace.$note: Second real third-party brand (Shoelace @shoelace-style/shoelace CEM -> Sl.* Elm). Now the generation-STAGING ROOT only: its published single-package identity is RETIRED (see PACKAGES-MOVED.md) — the five split siblings below are the product. No copyFidelity block: newly stood up in-workspace, no published jackhp95/elm-shoelace mirror snapshot to compare against yet (same as elm-typed-html). Add one when the mirror is first published.

packages.$comment_elm_shoelace_split_siblings: The five committed split siblings materialized by the shoelace-split task (docs/dag-rework-plan). Emitted by `elm-cem split --out=..` from elm-shoelace/packages.json, mirroring the m3e/html precedent. The monolith's docs.json blew the 700 KB registry cap (947,500 B / 135.4%) once the DAG rework added the 58-module degenerate Sl.Component.* facade tier; the split resolves it structurally. Shoelace's DAG is linear (core <- elements <- components <- build; facts standalone) and its namespaces already align with the tiers, so no namespace-rename was needed (unlike m3e Task 7). Five tiers (no -icons: shoelace has no Sl.Icon tier). No copyFidelity block yet: no published jackhp95/* mirror snapshot to compare against (same as elm-typed-html/elm-shoelace, OQ-6). Split-tier docs.json (validate --packages): core 245,939 B (35.1%), elements 193,949 B (27.7%), components 252,737 B (36.1%), build 254,878 B (36.4%) — all well under cap, with headroom for the families-a11y branch's composition admits/roles.json data (which lands on the components/build tiers and independently pushed the monolith to 706 KB on its own branch).
